items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: My father's name was William Alexander. I was named after him

ctx.x: How much do you know about your family background before --

My family background. I can remember all of my family. My mother's name was Elizabeth. My father's name was William Alexander. I was named after him but they always called me from the time I remember Son. They would say Son, and then they changed it to Sonny. My mother was a modiste and my father is master electrician for the Pennsylvania Railroad.

I have two sisters and a brother. They have all passed away now, but I remember them very well, and the funny part about it, I became a drummer by purely accident. It was nobody in my family musically inclined. You hear a lot
